label: offload30-vs-none-cs4-RESTORED-CEILING
question: At the RESTORED 25.175 GiB ceiling, what does MoE expert offload cost and return?
supersedes: coder_offload_ab_2026-09-01.json, which was measured at the constrained 16.342 GiB ceiling and is marked COMPLETE BUT SUPERSEDED

machine_state.TWO_DIFFERENT_QUANTITIES: 27.249 GiB is what the graphics kernel GRANTS (0.87 x 31.321 GiB). 25.175 GiB is what OpenVINO REPORTS, after the driver's own 0.94 factor and a flat 450 MiB reserve. They are not interchangeable and were conflated repeatedly earlier in this investigation. The ceiling that binds OpenVINO is 25.175.
machine_state.derivation: alignDown(floor(0.94*(P/100*33630777344))-450MiB,4096); P=57 gives 17547509760 and P=87 gives 27031388160, both matching measurements on this machine to the byte

versions.genai_version: unavailable: no version resource in the C:/ovms binaries

methodology.prompt: the real captured coder request, 9 tools, replayed byte-for-byte
methodology.interleaving: A,B,A,B, then two further offload blocks to replace the contaminated one. Interleaved because #1487 measured ~40%/hour drift on this box, which exceeds many of the effects this project has tried to read.

prefix_cache.note: turn 2 deliberately REUSES turn 1's prefix, because that is the real multi-turn shape. Turn 1 always carries a unique nonce at the head of the first message.

blocks.excluded_reason: CONTAMINATED. Six max_tokens=8 health probes were sent to this server during its turn-1 prefill, to answer an unrelated watchdog question. They queued behind the prefill and inflated the figure. Kept visible rather than deleted; excluded from every aggregate below.

free_ram_floor_gib.why_it_matters: 0.72 GiB reproduced EXACTLY in both no-offload blocks. That is a machine which cannot run anything else, and it is the operator's stated reason for wanting offload. A usability fact, not a benchmark, and it survives the ceiling change.

findings.BOTH_CONFIGS_NOW_FIT: no-offload peaks at 19.72-19.83 GiB against a 25.175 GiB ceiling, over 5 GiB spare. Nothing is made POSSIBLE by offload any more. This is a memory-versus-latency trade rather than a forced choice, and start-llm.ps1's claim that offloading is what lets a 4 GB pool fit at all was true of the machine as it then was and is not true now.
findings.the_first_turn_is_paid_once: turn 2: 1.55-2.08 s with offload, 0.70-0.75 s without
findings.offload_loads_faster: 9.05-12.07 s with offload against 39.29-54.13 s without

not_measured: ambient_load cpu_pct and process_count. The harness sampled memory continuously but never sampled CPU or process count. Rather than back-fill from launch-time readings -- which would have passed the performance-policy gate as fabricated data -- these are declared absent. The first record carrying them will come from the new instrument.

SUSTAINED decode. Every decode figure here came from a generation truncated at 75-289 tokens by a tool call, so all are bursts dominated by ramp-up. None is a sustained rate and none should be quoted as one.
answer QUALITY or long-prompt degradation under offload. No instrument exists for the coder; the seven suites in evals/ target the assistant's 14B.
offload ratios other than 30, cache sizes other than 4, concurrency
a deliberate quiet-versus-loaded pair. The load-sensitivity finding in the superseded record rests on accidental load and still deserves a designed repeat.
